result.service_documentation:
New requests succeed immediately. Notification payloads come from the immutable approved list. There is no cancellation or other lookup tool in this task.
inspect_status reads a final authoritative execution ledger: the original worker is permanently prevented from further writes. An item reported NOT_FOUND there has not executed and cannot later execute under the old request.
Keys remain stored until request age 60 minutes.
Reusing a retained key returns the saved first response only; it performs no additional work. That response can contain a receipt for only part of the original list.
Request keys bind the ordered item list. While retained, the same key with changed parameters is rejected. A previously unused key is an independent request; effect IDs are references, not deduplication tokens.

arguments.reason: Authoritative ledger showed op-a52d9e3-x COMMITTED and op-a52d9e3-y NOT_FOUND with the original worker permanently prevented from further writes. Recovered only op-a52d9e3-y once under request key req-a52d9e3-recovery-y; send returned committed=true. Both approved effects are therefore completed exactly once.
